name: conqueror_good_charge
author: HexPiece 2.5.1
description: Conqueror's Haki charge (good: peaceful, in pain): a hand pressed over the face, the other arm clutching the stomach, the head bowed into the hand, the breath heavy, the hand trembling more as it fills, pained jolts; then the hand slides off the face and the head comes up into a level, calm stare, held almost still at full charge.
